outputCopy.heroIntroduction: For residents in Worsbrough seeking healthcare support, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic provides the Pharmacy First service. This initiative allows local people to receive professional consultations with a qualified pharmacist for certain common health conditions, helping to manage routine healthcare needs effectively within the community.
outputCopy.localIntroduction:
Worsbrough is a historic settlement situated directly south of Barnsley in South Yorkshire. The area encompasses several distinct localities, including Worsbrough Village, Worsbrough Dale, Worsbrough Bridge and Worsbrough Common, reflecting a rich heritage that combines former industrial activity with rural landscape elements across the Dove Valley.

The local area contains significant green spaces and historic landmarks, notably Worsbrough Mill and Country Park, which features a 17th-century working watermill, a large reservoir and a designated nature reserve. The Trans Pennine Trail passes through the neighbourhood, offering walking routes alongside local community facilities. Primary healthcare provision in the district is delivered by local GP surgeries and health centres.

To support local healthcare access, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic provides Pharmacy First consultations for eligible people from Worsbrough. Pharmacy First covers certain common health conditions, allowing patients to discuss their needs directly with a pharmacist. During the consultation, the pharmacist assesses symptoms, relevant medicines and medical history. The outcome may include advice, suitable treatment or referral to another healthcare professional, with eligibility and treatment depending on the individual clinical assessment.
outputCopy.relationshipToPharmacy: Consultations take place at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield. Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is approximately 5.6 km in a straight line from Worsbrough.
